name: DeblurNeRF
aliases: Deblur-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from Blurry Images
definition: A method that learns a deformable sparse kernel to warp ray origins to approximate spatially varying blur, relying on an MLP to model local ray mixing.
summary: DeblurNeRF reconstructs sharp NeRFs from blurry images by jointly optimizing the field and a learnable spatially-varying blur kernel, unlike methods using fixed priors.
